reviews.author: Hamza L

reviews.title: Worst Experience
reviews.text: I had an incredibly disappointing experience with Royal Air Maroc at Washington Dulles airport. My husband, child, and I needed assistance, but the airline staff failed to provide any meaningful help. Initially, they claimed we didn't have tickets, but later found our reservation. However, they couldn't locate my husband's ticket and instructed us to contact customer service. I promptly called customer service, and they assured me that my ticket had been processed and I had 15 minutes to check in at the counter. Despite being at the ticket counter and explaining my situation, the staff didn't listen to me, closed up, and left. As someone who is legally blind, I found their behavior to be incredibly rude and insensitive. To add insult to injury, when I contacted Royal Air Maroc for a refund, they unjustly claimed it was a no-show situation. They directed me to fill out a complaint and refund form, which I promptly did on June 9. However, despite my numerous attempts to call them from June 9 until June 23, I have received no response whatsoever. This entire experience has been the worst I have ever encountered. The lack of assistance, the dismissive attitude, and the subsequent lack of response regarding my refund have left me deeply disappointed with Royal Air Maroc.
reviews.author: sumaya j

reviews.title: Worst company ever
reviews.text: They removed me from the flight without notice at 3 am. They charged me an extra 750$ to get my tickets back. When I tried to get a reimbursment, they told me they had no complaint service. Worst company I have ever seen, do NOT fly with them.
reviews.author: Anouni

reviews.title: Worst Airline Ever
reviews.text: My mom and I used this airline to get to and from Spain. On our way home they lost our luggage. Luckily we have air tags and know that they are at the airport in Casablanca. We landed at home in the US and there was not a single Royal air maroc employee in the airport in order to make our claim (we looked everywhere we could). We used the website to try to make a claim but we needed our claim number. We tried calling for 4 hours to get a claim number. Every person said we must return to the airport when there was a departing flight. So we drove the 4 hours to the airport. Asked the ticketing people and we’re told to wait for a specific person. They called him a few time and he never showed. Over 2.5 hours of waiting.. nothing. They closed the counter and left l, said he’d be right there. 30 more minutes… still no one. We left. Tried calling again to explain the situation. “We can’t do that over the phone, you have to go to the airport” is what we keep hearing. How the hell do we get our luggage back!!!!
reviews.author: Sarah Z

reviews.title: The worst airline
reviews.text: Ringer 7 minutes ago The worst airline I've even been, the flight was hot like a sauna the whole time from Casablanca to Miami I couldn't sleep I was very dehydrated I felt like I was gonna pass out the seat was uncomfortable the cushion was so hard like you sitting on rock the food was only one option eat it or leave it nothing to watch most of movie are old I spend $6k on 3 tickets it was NOT worth at all it was a nightmare . 0 star not recommend
reviews.author: sue

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: We flew round trip from Miami to Malaga Spain. Both ways we had layovers in Casablanca. The way to Spain it was 5 hours. The way home it was an overnight layover. I read that they would give a free room for overnight layovers, but I couldn’t find anyone to contact to arrange for that. Then, our flight home was further delayed by an additional five hours which Connors back to Miami at 2 o’clock in the morning! Our luggage was not at baggage claim. Airport security told us to talk to the Royal air. Maroc representative, who was supposed to be at the carousel, but there was no one to be found. So, we tried going to the ticket area to find anybody from Royal air Maroc, but at 2 o’clock in the morning there was, no one. As of this writing, I have put in a ticket for our luggage and also to see if they would compensate us for the extended delay. It is very difficult to figure out how and whom to contact anyone and finally had to try doing a form, which said would give me an automatic reply to my email when it was complete. That was an hour and a half ago and I have no automatic response and no way of knowing if they’ve received my ticket or how to follow up on it. There website says to arrive three hours early for an international flight and another place on the confirmation, said four hours early, but no one shows up until two hours early for any of them. On our final leg, my daughters video screen was non-functional to boot. The food was decent. That’s the only positive. We will never fly with them again.
reviews.author: Carolyn S

reviews.title: DONT WASTE YOUR MONEY AND TIME
reviews.text: - the toilets are often in a disgusting state when you arrive in the aircraft (they don’t clean between flights, leaving all the dirty from the flight before, nothing I have ever seen on other flights, and I have flown hundreds and hundreds of times). - flight attendant opened the bathroom while it was locked before take-off, and without even knocking! - the food options are not great, especially non-meat options. - some airplanes are very worn out: my seat had NO SEATBELT, it was on the floor, and I was terrified to seat there and the belt would break again so I requested to change seat because I didn’t want to travel with a broken seatbelt and they did a quick fix (which I'm pretty sure in case of emergency the belt would not hold me on my seat) and they told me that it was not possible to switch seats. Also, some armchairs were falling off. - no entertainment options or charging outlets on planes. - no warning of certain scheduled routes (e.g., the Guinea-Bissau stop in the Casablanca-Praia route).
reviews.author: Mariana M

reviews.title: The Worst Travel Experience Ever!
reviews.text: I recently flew round trip from JFK to BCN with a layover in Casablanca each way with Royal Air Maroc and can confidently say that unless I am left with no other choice, I will NOT be flying this airline again. It all started a few days before the first flight when my family and I noticed that there was a typo in my name; after spending 4+ hours on the phone, most of which I was on hold or trying to reach someone to speak to, the only option they presented me with was that I had to cancel my ticket and purchase another round trip ticket for over $2,000 USD - a markup of over 100% than my original ticket! They would not apply any credit from my original booking to the new one they forced me to buy or even attempt to confirm my identity through my passport, drivers license, or birth certificate. The customer service representatives on the phone were not helpful, loud, rude, and dismissive. On top of all this, both the first and connecting flight had open seats around the plane and I was obviously lied to that the flights were “fully booked” and that in order to travel I needed to purchase a new ticket. I have proof of the empty seats on both flights. Next, in Casablanca I attempted to be switched to the flight that the rest of my family was on as I knew that seats were still available and the representative at the desk did not even bother to stand up from her chair behind the high counter and continued her conversation in her AirPod while telling me that there was nothing possible to be done and pointing to my ticket. Once again, an unprofessional, rude, and dismissive interaction. If I had more energy I would tell you about the atrocious experiences I had with the cabin crew themselves ON EACH FLIGHT - to speak lowly on and degrade a passenger standing RIGHT in front of them in a different language assuming they don’t understand and won’t say anything left me speechless. I have flown a lot, worked in customer service, and have never been treated in such a way. It is appalling to see that an airline which prides itself to be part of the OneWorld Alliance treat its passengers this way. These OneWorld airlines promise “the highest level of service and convenience” but I experienced the exact opposite. Budget airlines, like Spirit and Frontier, don’t even treat you like this! A typo that could have been very easily corrected resulted in one of, if not, the worst travel experience in my life. I demand that this be corrected for me and that no other person go through a similar situation. I am not one who leaves negative and lengthy reviews, as this one is, but feel that this entire experience was outright ridiculous and deserved nothing less. I caution everyone from flying with Royal Air Maroc and inform you to be prepared for the worst.

reviews.title: Great hosting and lovely food
reviews.text: Great airline. The staff were genuinely welcoming and we felt like we were being hosted. The food was excellent too. We took our wheelie bags + rucksack on board, for the overhead lockers, no problem. Also, we had to refund my friend's ticket as she couldn't come and it was very quick and easy to arrange. Impressive.

reviews.author: Oaa E

reviews.title: Incredible country, worst airline
reviews.text: It is such a shame that this airline is so freaking terrible. This is my first trip to Morroco, and I absolutely recommend coming to this beautiful country. I travel all around the world for business, and have never come across an airline that cares less about the quality of service. When arriving at the airport, we got in line to get our tickets. The very unpleasant employees for the airline proceeded to tell me I needed a visa to travel back to Spain. He went to talk to management and found out he was completely wrong. I proceeded to ask him for an upgraded seat in which he ignored me and didn't help after asking many times. Fast forward to boarding the plane, there was an very long wait board time. Entering the plane, there were so many open seats and plenty in first class. There is no air conditioning, and it was probably 95 degrees in the plane while we were waiting to take off with absolutely no air ventilation. Very uncomfortable and honestly miserable. Again, I met so many beautiful and friendly people in Morroco. And I so highly recommend you visit here if you love a vast and interesting history, beautiful architecture, and rich culture. It is such a shame that this airline leaves such a sour taste in my mouth. I will definitely be coming back to Morroco because I am in love with it, but I will make sure all my friends and family will never use this terrible airline. If I could give a negative star rating I definitely would. Wishing anyone that reads this an amazing journey where ever that may take you.
reviews.author: Casey D

reviews.title: Lost luggage
reviews.text: We flew from Miami to Casablanca. Somehow our luggage were not sent. We waited 2 hours then r Filed a report to be sent to out next destination, Fez. We were there for 2 days. It took them 4 days to send them there, by that time we were in the Sahara and heading back to Casablanca. I called them before they sent them to Fez and asked simply to keep them in Casablanca but they didn’t do it, even though they keep assuring they will. Then never sent them back to Casablanca. We spend our vacation without our luggage and going back to US without them. Poor communication and lack of professionalism are the two features of this airline.

reviews.title: They stole my money
reviews.text: THIS COMPANY HAS TO BE CANCELLED. I hope this company gets illegalized and owners are jailed for stealing customers money. Still waiting for a refund after the stressful situation they put me in and the flight cancelled.
reviews.author: jprieto87

reviews.title: Did not have to be the worst
reviews.text: Lack of communication. Impacted by the airport strikes across Europe and this review does not hold the airline responsible for what caused the delay, this review does address their response and customer service. Flight from BCN to CMN became delayed due to strikes and the airline never provided updates to what was causing the delay until pressed and relied on the phrase "I don't know" as the standard response. Their lack of effort to provide updates created massed confusion and anxiety amongst the passengers. The flight attendant walked off and never returned, airport personnel eventually arrived, and the flight took off 3 hours delayed. This delay in leaving resulted in half the passengers missing their connecting flights to IAD, JFK and MIA. Upon arrival at CMN we were not met by any RAM personnel and after 20 minutes a young lady arrived and was confused by what we were asking. She also got up and left without providing answers. When RAM personnel equipped to handle the situation arrived new boarding passes were issued and incorrect guidance was passed that almost resulted in being arrested for illegal entry into the country. This mistake was clearly avoidable and demonstrates a lack of customer service which previous reviews indicate as a problem. From my own experience this is a cultural problem. The airline did provide a hotel for an overnight stay. This hotel did not have any towels and advised to use the sheets on the bed as a towel. Cultural food was provided however and was delivered in a disrespectful manner. The flight the next day did occur and the flight from CMN to IAD was normal. The inflight entertainment was lacking as a large number of screens did not work properly, one of them mine. There is no work around other than changing seats. If you like yogurt this airline is for you as you will get plenty of it. Staff aboard the aircraft were friendly and responsive. Ultimately, I can see this airline excelling without adversity. Once adversity is introduced, the wheels come off and they are unable to communicate effectively and provide a clear path forward. I will avoid this airline in the future based solely on their lack of customer service.

reviews.title: DO NOT BOOK

A day late for everything. Royal Air Maroc is out of compliance with US DOT flyer’s rights for long delay compensation issued 5/723. Shame on Royal Air Maroc. Won’t be flying with them again.
reviews.author: DC

reviews.title: Poor service, disorganized, but got us there safely
reviews.text: Our outbound flight from JFK was mostly as-planned with one exception. I’d called ahead to confirm they could accommodate dietary restrictions (I’m Celiac). Following the correct process, I could see on my itinerary that I’d requested a gluten-free meal. On-board at dinner time, I mentioned this to the attendant, who responded with ‘we have no idea what you’re talking about….pasta, chicken or fish?’. Fast forward 7 hours wherein I ate only yogurt. It was good yogurt, but I hadn’t grabbed other food because so many meals were planned for this flight. On the return, we got a message that the flight was delayed 2 hours. We later got an e-mail it was back on-track; all immaterial because we’re seasoned travelers and know that a delay doesn’t assure you time to luxuriate at the hotel. Prior to take-off, the projections suggested connections were still within reach, but immediately prior to take-off (on taxi), the pilot projected a landing time well beyond our connection, but it was too late to call and make changes. Boarding: They re-examined our luggage for contraband: liquids and powders. All water purchased in the terminal was confiscated. Boarding in A, B, C or D (maybe E) groups effectively just got you to busses taking us to the plane on the tarmac. The 2 rolling stairs were divided between 1st/Business Class, and everyone else. People who were WAY behind us ended up in front of us. It was inefficient and chaotic. We took off more than 3 hours late. Despite confiscating our water, they were not forthcoming with any on-board. My friend asked 3 times before finally getting a cup of water…..which was collected by the attendant (still 1/2 full) when she napped. It was never replaced. Upon landing in JFK, there was no explanation about connections, compensation for overnight, etc. All connections were missed and we booked quickly at the TWA Hotel (stay there even if you’re not stuck!) It was nice having a nonstop to Casablanca and we arrived safely. Still, I’d explore options before booking this airline again.

I made hotel, tour arrangements for myself in both locations. I drove from ohio to NyC and night before try to check in for my flight. It said there was no reservation. Tried to resolve. They refuse to deal with you and said basically you SOL. I had to purchase new tickets on different airline. Cancel my leg in Casablanca and book on entirely different airline because they were going to charge nearly 3 thousand dollars for what cost only 750 dollars originally. They refused to credit the ticket and insisted my friend canceled both.

reviews.title: The worst airline I’ve ever been on.
reviews.text: This airline is so bad even when the Moroccans tell you not to fly on it. My return flight was two hours late so I missed my connection. I arrived at at 1 AM, and they gave me a voucher for a room and breakfast and supper at the hotel and also I was to receive transportation to and from the hotel. They then booked me for a flight where I had to be back at the airport at 4:30 AM only 3 1/2 hours after arrival. When I got to the hotel, I was informed that breakfast started at 5 o’clock so I would not be able to get breakfast. I know Shuttle did not start until 5 AM so I could not get the shuttle, the flight attendants were extremely rude and made no attempt to assist customers. I wanted to upgrade the business class, but they said because my connecting flight with was JetBlue they couldn’t upgrade me. Hard to believe they didn’t want my money. This is a terrible airline always late pay the extra money and go with some other airline . My seat for the seven hour flight was broken the whole way so every time I tried to push the seat back and sleep it threw me forward the flight attendant receipts a switched me to open seat.

reviews.title: Very poor service
reviews.text: Flight AT208 April 24/2023 ETKT 01472420112932 To start with I don’t understand why your staff doesn’t follow the zone code seats. They let everyone goes on the same time than we have to wait over 15 minutes on the escalator waiting to board because zone D mixed with the other zone. Seat # 17J screen headphone port was damaged & broken and to top it up a Moroccan lady with a body odour is not your fault but I couldn’t seat next to her for the next 7 hours. Asked chef de cabine Madame GZIRI for help. She said there’s no empty seats. After checking by my self I found 2 empty seats in business class (broken). I asked her if she could offer me a seat I don’t need to watch the screen any more. I just need to sleep couple of hours because I have to drive 5 hours from Montreal to Toronto. Her answer was absolutely no chance to give away a seat in the business class it’s way above her capacity even it’s broken. I think your staff is unpowered to take decisions they have no idea how to deal or resolve issues. So I spent next 6 hours on my feet standing the all flight and I paid money for the ticket. Notice your staff on holidays were given 2 seats next to the emergency exit by the coffee station & I’m sure didn’t pay any money. where is your customer service? Also the flight AT209 ETKT 1471115922267 on the 31 of March from Montreal to Casablanca was cancelled and you made me stay at the hotel for 2 nights & change my layover from 4 hours to 22 hours. I even asked your staff to help me find an empty seat so I don’t have to spend 22 hours layover. I have to do the work by myself in Casablanca to manage to get an empty seat same day. I lost 3 days of my vacation that cost me almost a $1000 if I was working.time is money. I will appreciate if you consider a compensation or even a full refund due to the poor customer service and the poor experience received from your staff on and out of the plane for the first time I fly with RAM. These issues are very minor and easy to fix but your unprofessional staff ignores the standard of the job. Empty seats and they said the plane is full Thanks.

reviews.title: RAM promotes separating children from their parents in the cabin.
reviews.text: Based on when you "check in" for your flight, your family (even with small children) will be separated from each other. What's even better is that the flight attendants will blame it all on you and support young children sitting between strangers. There is not explanation of the "system" for travelers. Service is not the goal of the flight attendants- proving that you're an idiot is their number one priority. This airline is an embarrassment to Morocco. Plan to spend more time on the tarmac bus than on the airplane itself. Also plan on seeing every seat reclined and every tray table down for take off and landing. I would encourage RAM to "keep it classy" but I know they can't. Since they have a monopoly on these routes there is no hope for change. And don't even get me started on their call center... The next decent act of customer service on their part will be the first.

reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text: On my flight from Casablanca to Lisbon the flight attendant was rude, incompetent, condescending and not helpful. I had issues putting my carry on luggage in the overhead bin and this woman refused to help me place luggage in the appropriate location. She vaguely told me to carry my bag somewhere up front where the pilots store their luggage and wouldn’t lift a finger to assist me. It looked like this particular flight attendant was used to speaking down to passengers of a certain demographic because her attitude was absolutely ridiculous. Avoid this airline like the plague unless you looking to deal with arrogant and unhelpful employees. There is a reason why the have horrible reviews in the first place. Fly at the risk of experiencing crap customer service. The only reason I flew with them is was because I was stuck.

reviews.title: Extremely terrible service!!!
reviews.text: We got delayed in Accra for hours only to miss our connecting flight to London. Hence, I had to stay overnight in Casablanca. At Casablanca, the food was very poor with no vegan options. The hostel room was dusty with dirty used bedsheets and dirty bathrooms as well We could not find neither toothbrush not toothpaste, or even towels at the duty free shops. Their stuff were very extremely rude and were not remorseful. Some people amongst us had to stay for 2-3 nights because there were no vacancies in the next connecting flights to their respective destinations. And when we complained, instead of feeling remorseful and issuing apologies, they’d rather tell us to go back to Ghana and join another airline. I missed a very important meeting, the very reason why I had to travel, hence my trip was in vain 🥲, thanks to the incompetence and inefficiency of the airline I chose!! It’s been more than a month now and no one has reached out to apologise for all the opportunities we lost because of their failed operations. There’s no way I’d advise anyone to choose Royal air maroc. IN SUMMARY, IT WAS A HORRIBLE EXPERIENCE!!!
reviews.author: Mary E

reviews.title: Worst company ever seen!
reviews.text: The worse company ever seen in my life, super expensive and with such a lame service. Flight attendant rude and mean, people smoking on the flight and no one to tell them to stop (even though I warned many times the flight attendants, and they were kids/elders on the flight). No water or food during Ramadan which is normally the basics in a Arab flight company...no electricity in the plane when landing and landed, i mean how can this happened in the 21 century?! If you are lucky your flight will be clean, if not it's normal to sit on a bunch of biscuits and used paper. And if you ever have a problem with a luggage or a cancellation of flight good luck for at least years of battle with them to get your money back! I mean how can that company still goes on with such a lame service, I've traveled the world and see many things but that : never ! It's getting worse every flight! Poor Africa for having such a bad company!

reviews.title: One hundred percent poor service
reviews.text: This is one airline that seems to have achieved excellence in poor customer care, disorganization and lack of professionalism. Our flight, leaving Dulles Airport, was delayed by 6 hours and we only found out when we checked in. As a result, we missed our connecting flight to Rome in Casablanca and not one agent could identify a solution to the problem. We were told to fly to Casablanca and figure it out there. There was nothing Royal about their services, unless we took into account the level of incompetence and poor performance they displayed. To top it all off, the story repeated itself on our flight back from Bologna to Dulles Airport. Due to the delayed departure from Bologna we (once again) missed the connecting flight to Dulles Airport in Casablanca and were redirected to New York, JFK. Did I mention that on both occasions we had to spend the night in Casablanca in a dingy hotel room provided by the Royal Air Maroc?
reviews.author: Angela D

reviews.title: UNBELIEVABLE AND INCONCEIVABLE
reviews.text: Booked on March 09, showed up at the airport on March 18 to fly. JetBlue tells me I'm not on their passenger list and to call the company i booked with - which sadly was RAM. I called RAM, they say my flight was cancelled - mind you: without my consent/knowledge and RAM still had the money for the flight $1420 / two ways. I ended up buying the same exact ticket RAM's ""customer service "" said was cancelled and paid $ 1600 one way. The craziest thing is: THERE IS NO SOLUTION ONCE I CALLED RAM TO FIND OUT WHAT HAPPENED. I contacted/spoke the following list of RAM's agents with no ANSWERS: 1-- At JFK. 2-- at Casablanca's airport location. 3--- at City of Fez main location. 4-- telephone customer service ( in the US and in Morocco) . Bottom line is my experience was INCONCEIVABLE AND UNBELIEVABLE. To add insult to injury i have to buy a one way ticket back to Chicago. Therefore, it's gonna cost me $ 2500 minimum when I bought a ticket from RAM that they cancelled on me per the customer service without my consent or knowledge. AND i received my 1400$ back on March 23 after I filled a charge dispute with my bank, not because RAM returned it. It's UNBELIEVABLE how this company does business and treats passengers in total disregard to the bare minimum of customer service. I filled a complaint with RAM and still no response after 12 days of filling it. I can NOT find words to describe my experience besides STAY AWAY FROM RAM.
reviews.author: Youness

reviews.title: Zero customer service!
reviews.text: When my luggage finally arrived, it was wrapped in a plastic bag completely shredded!! The lid of my bag was hanging by the zipper. My belongings were there but torn, dirty and crushed! I started to file a claim and realized I had no time to completely sort through my belongings to see what was destroyed and list it's value per item. The guy said I could also file on their website which is what I did. Now after months of emails and very little reply from RMA they are refusing my claim because I didn't file it at the airport. I am so frustrated with their lack customer service and communication. They also tried to cancel our return flight and tried to charge us again to go home. That is a whole other story! I will never fly with them again!

reviews.title: WORST AIRLINE!
reviews.text: WORST AIRLINE EXPERIENCE I EVER HAD! They overbooked their flight sufficiently to fill a bus from Marrakech to Casablanca. They lied to customers, saying the flight was canceled. Once in Casablanca, the flight back to the USA was also overbooked and they lied again, saying the flight had already left. They rescheduled the flight for over 24h later. Then, getting them to pay for accommodation and transportation actually took convincing! Then, everyone had to wait for them to fill another bus with people in the same situation to take us to a crappy hotel and I had to sit on the bus's stairs because the bus was also overbooked. Finally, the hotel is so crappy that it costs USD 30/night, wifi is so slow it doesn't work, and the room smells like sewage. SPARE YOURSELF!!
reviews.author: Eduardo

reviews.title: Nothing is Royal about this airline
reviews.text: We had low quality service every step of the way. We received an email to checkin but could not choose seats or complete the checkin. We ended paying $270 to choose regular seats to ensure that we are together (we have an adult with special needs). We purchased the seats to avoid the risk of not sitting together. It felt like the airline was black mailing us by opening the checkin process and refusing to allow us to choose seats together. During the process of purchasing seats, the airline website failed to use PayPal and charged us twice for the seats. We had to call the airline several times to get a refund. Thankfully, PayPal was able to refund us after 10 days wait. The food on the plane was really terrible. The return was no better, the web site refused to allow us to complete checkin again online or choose our seats. The lines at Cairo airport were absolutely crazy. We waited over 1 hour to get our boarding passes. Just hard to believe that in 2023, an airline can have such a terrible customer service every step of the way. This has been our first time with RAM and we will never repeat even if we have free tickets. Seriously, this has been our worst travel experience and we have traveled a lot. I wish I read the reviews before booking with them.
